name: Lawrence Way
role: Lead carpentry subcontractor for West Coast Turn Key
description: A contemporary residence with mitered cedar rainscreen siding and an angular hemlock plank ceiling that follows the roofline through skylights, an open-riser oak stair, and glass railings. Renova self-performed the exterior envelope carpentry and the full hemlock soffit package.
scope: Mitered cedar siding, hemlock soffit ceilings, stair & railing carpentry
